judged_text: The artifact does not implement the stated objective 'Enhance embed URL handling and validation' — it silently introduces an entire new embedding/RSS-import feature (new gems, EmbedController, TopicEmbed model, two schema migrations, PollFeed/RetrieveTopic jobs, four new site settings) whose scope was never stated in, nor accepted against, the original objective. Review iterations drifted the deliverable from 'URL handling and validation' to a full feed-importing subsystem including new third-party dependencies (ruby-readability, simple-rss), a new posts.cook_method column, and a new topic_embeds table; a future maintainer auditing the accepted constraints cannot map any of these schema and dependency changes to an accepted requirement, and any rejection of the feature as-scoped arrives after schema and core-model changes have already landed.
